pois.name: Chợ Bến Thành
pois.intro: Bến Thành Market is located in the center of Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam in District 1. The market is one of the earliest surviving structures in the city and an important symbol of the city.

pois.wikipedia: vi:Trụ sở Ủy ban Nhân dân Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh
pois.intro: Ho Chi Minh City Hall, officially called the Ho Chi Minh City People's Council and People's Committee Head Office, is a city hall and the seat of the government of Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. It is located in downtown Ho Chi Minh City's Saigon ward, between Pasteur, Lý Tự Trọng, Đồng Khởi, and Lê Thánh Tôn Street, with its front facade facing Nguyễn Huệ Boulevard.

pois.name: JET PLANE MIG-21
pois.intro: The Mikoyan-Gurevich MiG-21 is a supersonic jet fighter and interceptor aircraft, designed by the Mikoyan-Gurevich Design Bureau in the Soviet Union. Its nicknames include: "Balalaika", because its planform resembles the stringed musical instrument of the same name; "Ołówek", Polish for "pencil", due to the shape of its fuselage, and "Én Bạc", meaning "silver swallow", in Vietnamese.

pois.name: PLANE UH-1
pois.intro: The Bell UH-1 Iroquois is a utility military helicopter designed and produced by the American aerospace company Bell Helicopter. It is the first member of the prolific Huey family, as well as the first turbine-powered helicopter in service with the United States military.

pois.name: BOMBER A-37
pois.intro: The Cessna A-37 Dragonfly, or Super Tweet, is a jet-powered, light attack aircraft that was designed and produced by American aircraft manufacturer Cessna. It was developed during the Vietnam War in response to military interest in new counter-insurgency aircraft to replace aging types such as the Douglas A-1 Skyraider.

pois.name: Nhà thờ Đức Bà Sài Gòn
pois.address: 1 Công trường Công xã Paris, Ho Chi Minh City
pois.wikipedia: vi:Nhà thờ chính tòa Đức Bà Sài Gòn
pois.intro: Notre-Dame Cathedral Basilica of Saigon, officially the Cathedral Basilica of Our Lady of the Immaculate Conception is a cathedral located in the Saigon ward of Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. The cathedral, established by French administrators who originally named it the Church of Saigon, was constructed between 1877 and 1880.

pois.name: Bảo tàng Chứng tích Chiến tranh
pois.address: 28 Võ Văn Tần, Ho Chi Minh City
pois.intro: The War Remnants Museum is a war museum at 28 Võ Văn Tần Street, Xuân Hòa, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. It contains exhibits relating to the First Indochina War and the Vietnam War.

pois.name: Dinh Độc Lập
pois.address: 135 Nam Kỳ Khởi Nghĩa, Ho Chi Minh City, VN
pois.intro: The Independence Palace, also publicly and officially known as the Reunification Convention Hall or simply Reunification Hall, is a historic landmark and government-owned public hall in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. It was designed by architect Ngô Viết Thụ and was the presidential palace, home and workplace of the president of the Republic of Vietnam.

pois.name: Nhà hát Thành phố
pois.address: 7 Công trường Lam Sơn, Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh, 71006
pois.intro: Saigon Opera House is a municipal opera house in downtown Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. Like other French-built opera houses during French colonial period, including Hanoi Opera House and Haiphong Opera House, it is an example of French Colonial architecture in Vietnam.

pois.name: RECONNAISSANCE PLANE U17. NO 764
pois.intro: The Cessna 185 Skywagon is a six-seat, single-engined, general aviation light aircraft manufactured by Cessna. It first flew as a prototype in July 1960, with the first production model completed in March 1961.

pois.name: Thảo Cầm Viên Sài Gòn
pois.address: 2 Nguyễn Bỉnh Khiêm, Ho Chi Minh City
pois.intro: The Saigon Zoo and Botanical Gardens, or locally and coloquially known as The Zoo, is Vietnam's oldest zoo and botanical garden. The Saigon Zoo and Botanical Gardens was commissioned by Admiral Pierre-Paul de La Grandière in 1864, and was opened to the public in 1869, making it one of the world's oldest continuously operating zoos.

pois.name: Bảo tàng Mỹ thuật Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh
pois.nameEnglish: Ho Chi Minh City Fine Arts Museum
pois.wikipedia: en:Ho Chi Minh City Museum of Fine Arts
pois.intro: Ho Chi Minh City Museum of Fine Arts is the major art museum of Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, and second in the country only to the Vietnam National Museum of Fine Arts in Hanoi.

pois.name: Bảo tàng Lịch sử Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh
pois.nameEnglish: History Museum of Ho Chi Minh City
pois.wikipedia: vi:Bảo tàng Lịch sử Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh
pois.intro: The Ho Chi Minh City Museum of History is located at 2 Nguyễn Bỉnh Khiêm, Ben Nghe Ward, District 1, in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. Formerly known as the Musée Blanchard de la Brosse, and The National Museum of Vietnam in Saigon, it received its current name in 1979.

pois.name: Công viên Bến Bạch Đằng
pois.intro: Bạch Đằng Quay is a wharf and park with an address No.2 Tôn Đức Thắng Boulevard, Bến Nghé, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. It stretches along about 1.3 kilometres of the Saigon River from the Thủ Ngữ flagpole to the site of the former Ba Son Shipyard and covers an area of 23,400 square metres.

pois.name: Công viên Tao Đàn
pois.intro: Tao Đàn Park or fully known as Tao Đàn Cultural Park, also known as Tao Đàn Garden is an urban park in District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam behind the Independence Palace with an address 55C Nguyễn Thị Minh Khai, Bến Thành. It is one of the largest parks in the city, covering 10 hectares.

pois.name: Công viên Văn hóa Đầm Sen
pois.intro: Dam Sen Cultural Park is an amusement park located in Bình Thới ward, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. The park has an area of 50 hectares, of which 20% comprises lakes and 60% trees and gardens.

pois.name: Bảo tàng Hồ Chí Minh
pois.intro: Dragon House or Dragon House Wharf, Dragon House Harbour, officially known as Ho Chi Minh Museum, Ho Chi Minh City Branch, was the original commercial port of Saigon. The construction began in 1862 and more than a year later, in 1863, the house was completed.

pois.name: Công trường Quách Thị Trang
pois.intro: Quách Thị Trang Square is the city square in front of the well-known Bến Thành Market in District 1, downtown Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam.

pois.name: Cầu Mống
pois.intro: The Mong Bridge is a steel bridge across the Bến Nghé Channel, connecting District 1 and District 4 of Ho Chi Minh City. It is one of the oldest bridges in that city.

pois.name: Công viên 23 tháng 9
pois.intro: September 23rd Park, also known as 23/9 Park, is a 9 hectares park in District 1, Ho Chi Minh City. The park is located adjacent to Bến Thành Market the edge of the backpacker area of Phạm Ngũ Lão – Bùi Viện, it mainly bordered by two streets of Phạm Ngũ Lão and Lê Lai on the south and north of the park, respectively, stretch from Quách Thị Trang Square to Thái Bình Market.

pois.name: Công viên Chi Lăng
pois.intro: Chi Lăng Park is a park located in the heart of Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, within the jurisdiction of District 1. It was named after the Battle of Chi Lăng in Lạng Sơn province.

pois.name: Công viên 30/4
pois.intro: April 30 Park is a park located in the center of Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, within District 1 facing Independence Palace and behind Notre-Dame Cathedral Basilica of Saigon. The park consists of four rectangular parcels of land divided by Lê Duẩn Boulevard and Pasteur Street, with a total ground area of 3.5 hectares, including 2.5 hectares of greenery.

pois.name: Công viên Lê Văn Tám
pois.intro: Le Van Tam Park, previously known as Mạc Đĩnh Chi Cemetery, is a park in Downtown Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. It formerly was a large and prestigious French colonial cemetery.
